drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy without CC/MCC

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient seen and examined at bedside. 61-year-old male admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.87, creatinine 1.83, hemoglobin 13.2, lactate 1.2, platelets 272, sodium 139, wbc 12.7; vitals dbp 63-67, heart_rate 85-99, map 84-87, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 18-21, sbp 124-128, spo2 96-97, temp 37.6-38.6
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Blood cultures x2; Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient seen and examined at bedside. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 1.83, hemoglobin 13.4, platelets 271, sodium 139, wbc 11; vitals dbp 64-69, heart_rate 82-87, map 85-90, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-18, sbp 123-131, spo2 96-98, temp 37.3-37.5
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 61-year-old male, length of stay 3 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed.
